facts.fact: PAREC says the ministry of basic education held an official ceremony on 8 May 2025 presenting the integrated sectoral SIGE platform (sige-sectoriel.cm), designed to centralise statistics of all education and training subsectors and hosted by the National Institute of Statistics.
facts.system: plateforme sectorielle intégrée du Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)

systems.owner: Institut National de la Statistique (host); Ministère de l'Éducation de Base
